feeds.title: Chained Dog Awareness Blog
feeds.description: Inspire Compassion Towards Chained DogsIn 2015, Chained Dog Awareness Singapore was started. The non-profit organisation was founded to raise awareness of the plight of the many dogs chained across Singapore. We believe in upholding the Five Domains of Animal Welfare, a new model proposed by Professor David Mellor and Dr Cam Reid in 1994, as a means of systematically identifying and grading the severity of different forms of welfare compromise by reformulating the Five Freedoms as 'Five Domains' of nutrition, environment, health, behaviour and mental state
